funnel.title: Shot funnel
funnel.subtitle: Of every shot, how many were on target and how many ended in a goal.
funnel.subject: Shot funnel of {home} and {away}
funnel.note: The percentage is the part of each team's shots that reached that step.
funnel.ownGoals: Own goals do not come from a shot of the team: they are not counted here ({count}).
funnel.goalsFromScore: Goals taken from the score: the match events do not tell own goals apart.
funnel.method: Shots, shots on target and goals of each team in this match, as the provider delivers them. Each step is compared with the same team's shots. Goals come from the match events; if they do not add up to the score, from the score.

zones.title: Shot zone · 2 zones
zones.subtitle: Inside or outside the box: the two zones the provider delivers.
zones.subject: Shots inside and outside the box of {home} and {away}
zones.honest: These are the two zones the provider delivers. This is not a shot map: where each shot was taken is not known.
zones.method: The provider counts each team's shots inside and outside the box; the percentage is the part of that team's shots in each zone. It does not give where each shot was taken, so there is no map: only these two zones.
zones.aria: {team}: {inside} shots inside the box ({insidePct} %) and {outside} outside ({outsidePct} %)

balance.title: Match balance
balance.subject: Share of possession, shots and corners between {home} and {away}
balance.note: It shares out the match's totals between the two sides. It does not measure where on the pitch the match was played.
balance.method: Each bar is each side's part of the match's total of that figure (possession, shots, shots inside the box and corners), as the provider delivers it. It says who had more of each, not where it was played: hence an approximate dominance and not a «field tilt», which would need to know where each action happened.

scoreState.title: State of the score
scoreState.subtitle: Who was ahead during the 90 minutes.
scoreState.subject: Minutes ahead of {home} and {away}
scoreState.beyond90: The strip covers the 90 minutes: extra time and penalties are not drawn.
scoreState.method: The goals of the match events are put in order and, minute by minute, it is counted who was ahead, who behind or whether they were level. Stoppage time counts as minute 90 (45 in the first half). Drawn only when the goals of the events add up to the final score.
